steps.input:
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Fill each rectangular frame interior with its associated scattered color, checkerboard.
    frames={1:5, 2:8, 3:4}
    for color, fill in frames.items():
        cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
        if not cells: continue
        r0,r1=min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0,c1=min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                if (r-r0-1+c-c0-1)%2==0: g[r][c]=fill
    # erase isolated background markers, retaining only the three outlined objects
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if grid[r][c] not in (1,2,3): g[r][c]=0
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
out=transform(grid)
print(out)
